name: Personal and Household

definitions.title: Monthly tire pressure check

definitions.title: Quarterly HVAC filter change

definitions.title: Home insurance review
definitions.note: Review home and vehicle insurance before renewal.

definitions.title: Health checkup booking
definitions.note: Book the annual physical and dental checkups.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc home repair
